description: This file defines the FilterAuthEvent class which extends the Symfony Event class; it manages user authentication events, including user info, provider, and redirection logic within the Goteo application.

classes.name: FilterAuthEvent
classes.description: An event class representing user authentication states, with methods to manage user info and determine redirect URLs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the user and provider properties.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the current User object associated with the event.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the User object for the event.

methods.name: getUserRedirect
methods.description: Determines and returns the appropriate redirect response based on user roles, request parameters, and session data.
